evals.name: commit-with-conventional-style
evals.prompt: I have a working tree with staged changes. Commit them. The repo uses conventional-commits style — analyze recent commits to confirm. Do NOT push. Save the resulting commit's full message (just the message, not the SHA) to `outputs/commit-message.txt`. To set up: from the fixture, run `setup.sh` which initializes a git repo with seed history and stages a change.
evals.expected_output: A single new commit exists with a conventional-commits-format message in English. The message subject is on one line under 72 chars.
expectations: outputs/commit-message.txt exists in the outputs directory.
commit-message.txt's first line follows conventional commits format (matches regex `^(feat|fix|chore|docs|refactor|test|style|perf|ci|build)(\(.+\))?: `).
commit-message.txt's first line is 72 characters or fewer.
commit-message.txt's first line mentions the substantive change (contains at least one of: 'parser', 'nested', 'array').
commit-message.txt is in English (no Korean / non-ASCII narrative text in the message).
Exactly one new commit was created on top of the seeded history (verified via git log).
DISCRIMINATING: commit-message.txt's first line uses a scope `(parser)` (matches existing seed history scoping pattern, e.g., `feat(parser):`).

evals.name: pr-title-and-body-generation
evals.prompt: I have a feature branch with several commits ahead of main. Generate the PR title and body that would be used. Do NOT actually call `gh pr create` or push — just produce the artifacts. Save the proposed PR title to `outputs/pr-title.txt` and the proposed PR body to `outputs/pr-body.md`. To set up the fixture, run `setup.sh` which builds a git repo with main + a feature branch with 3 commits.
evals.expected_output: pr-title.txt is concise (under 70 chars), summarizes the cumulative branch work. pr-body.md has a structured body with at minimum a summary section and a test plan / checklist section. The branch name's ticket prefix (PROJ-123) is referenced.
expectations: outputs/pr-title.txt's content is 70 characters or fewer.
outputs/pr-body.md contains a `## Summary` (or `# Summary`) section.
outputs/pr-body.md contains a section about testing (matches case-insensitive regex `test plan|testing|how to test|test:`).
Either pr-title.txt or pr-body.md mentions the ticket identifier 'PROJ-123' from the branch name.
pr-title.txt is in English (no Korean characters).
DISCRIMINATING: pr-title.txt starts with a conventional-commits prefix (feat/fix/chore/etc.) matching the seed-history style.
DISCRIMINATING: pr-body.md contains a checkbox-style test plan (lines starting with `- [ ]` or `- [x]`).
